name: Garron the Returned

abilities.name: Necrotic Spear
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that does high magical damage. If taunted, the boss will be forced to use this attack on the tank only.

abilities.name: Necrotic Barrage
abilities.description: The boss launches many skulls that impact the ground around itself, as indicated by red circles. This attack does moderate magical damage.

abilities.name: Summon Escaped Souls
abilities.description: The boss summons four lich crystals around the room that do moderate magical damage as indicated by red circles. After the crystals explode, Escaped Souls are summoned at their positions. The party should kill these as soon as possible to simplify the fight.

abilities.name: Consume Life
abilities.description: The boss teleports to the center of the room and fires beams at all players. This attack does high magical damage over time and has to be healed through.

related_quests: No Second Chances: Return the Pellingare siblings to the grave.
Pledge: Wayrest Sewers II: Explore Wayrest Sewers II and return Undaunted.
summary: Garron the Returned is a lich, and the risen form of Investigator Garron, found within Wayrest Sewers II. It serves as the second boss that players must defeat to progress. His unique drop is Garron's Icy Grasp.
